nodes.summary: A group $F$ has this property when there exist elements $g, h \in F$ such that any two endomorphisms $\varphi, \psi$ of $F$ whose images are not cyclic subgroups and which satisfy $\varphi(g) = \psi(g)$ and $\varphi(h) = \psi(h)$ are equal.
nodes.title: Groups whose endomorphisms with non-cyclic images are determined by two elements

nodes.summary: For every natural number $n$, the free group $F_n$ of rank $n$ contains two elements $g$ and $h$ such that any two endomorphisms $\varphi, \psi$ of $F_n$ whose images are not cyclic subgroups and which satisfy $\varphi(g) = \psi(g)$ and $\varphi(h) = \psi(h)$ are equal.
nodes.title: Endomorphisms of free groups with non-cyclic images are determined by two elements

nodes.summary: For every natural number $n$, the free group $F_n$ of rank $n$ contains two elements $g$ and $h$ such that any two endomorphisms of $F_n$ whose images are not cyclic subgroups and which agree at $g$ and at $h$ are equal; that is, $F_n$ has its endomorphisms with non-cyclic images determined by two elements.
nodes.title: Shpil'rain's two-element problem for free groups (Kourovka 13.66(a))

nodes.summary: For a natural number $n$, let $M_n = F_n / F_n''$ be the free metabelian group of rank $n$, the quotient of the free group $F_n$ of rank $n$ by its second derived subgroup. There is an $n$ such that for all elements $g, h \in M_n$ there are endomorphisms $\varphi \ne \psi$ of $M_n$ whose images are not cyclic subgroups and which satisfy $\varphi(g) = \psi(g)$ and $\varphi(h) = \psi(h)$.
nodes.title: Endomorphisms of free metabelian groups are not always determined by two elements

nodes.summary: For every natural number $n$, the free metabelian group $M_n = F_n / F_n''$ of rank $n$ (the quotient of the free group $F_n$ of rank $n$ by its second derived subgroup) contains two elements $g$ and $h$ such that any two endomorphisms of $M_n$ whose images are not cyclic subgroups and which agree at $g$ and at $h$ are equal.
nodes.title: Shpil'rain's two-element problem for free metabelian groups (Kourovka 13.66(b))

nodes.summary: For a natural number $n$, the free metabelian group of rank $n$ is the quotient $F_n / F_n''$ of the free group $F_n$ on $n$ generators by its second derived subgroup $F_n'' = [F_n', F_n']$, where $F_n' = [F_n, F_n]$ is the derived subgroup of $F_n$.
nodes.title: The free metabelian group $M_n$
